top_signals.title: Bitwise launches first US spot NEAR ETF after token’s recent surge

top_signals.title: Reform UK and Tories attack Burnham’s triple lock pension move
top_signals.summary: Reform UK and Tory leaders have hit out at Andy Burnham’s plans to drop the triple lock on pensions in a future Labour manifesto, setting up a clash on a policy which previously had the backing of all major political parties.
